# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the problem and the approach taken.

## Validation

List the commands or checks that were run and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped and documented in English.
- [ ] Tests cover new behavior or explain why no test is needed.
- [ ] The complete Docker validation gate passes.
- [ ] No credentials, private hostnames, network addresses, production
      telemetry, or local filesystem paths are included.
- [ ] Documentation and release artifacts are updated when their public
      contract changes.
